Agent-optimized code visualization: index source trees into a queryable topology graph.

Usage: codetopo <COMMAND>

Commands:
  index         Walk a repo, extract symbols, and store the code graph
  descendants   Transitive closure over calls+imports edges (what this id affects)
  ancestors     Reverse of descendants: transitive callers/importers of this id
  blast-radius  What breaks if this changes: the dependents of the id, over calls, inherits, implements, reads/writes edges (imports alone does not break)
  path          Shortest typed path between two ids (edge-kind sequence)
  rank          Rank symbols by a measurement — fan-in, fan-out, blast-radius size, cyclomatic complexity, or a centrality measure (pagerank, betweenness, closeness, eigenvector, katz). A ranking of measurements (method stated in the output), never a score of code quality
  metrics       Coupling and cohesion measurements for every type and package: CBO, RFC, LCOM pair counts, TCC, ATFD, WMC, and package Ca/Ce/instability with external coupling named separately (CODE_SCHEMA §9). Measurements with stated methods — no thresholds, no verdicts
  communities   Community measurements: the Leiden partition of the dependency graph (CODE_SCHEMA §9) — community count, the partition's modularity Q, per-community sizes and edge counts, and every node's community. Measurements with a stated method — no thresholds, no verdicts
  topo-sort     The safe change order of the graph: topological order of the SCC-condensed dependency DAG (CODE_SCHEMA §9) — groups in dependency order, cycles returned as flagged groups, never disguised as an order
  history       Change-history measurements — hotspots and change coupling — from a local working tree's git history (CODE_SCHEMA §9). Local only: an index carries no history, so the working tree is named explicitly; a tree without history is answered "not measured", never zeros
  diff          Compare two indexes (or two snapshot files): added, removed, and changed nodes and edges, plus the blast-radius movement of every touched symbol — change-impact analysis (Bohner & Arnold) over two frozen graphs
  stats         Aggregate graph statistics: node/edge totals and per-kind counts
  render        Render the graph deterministically: a layout spec (JSON) and/or an SVG drawing of it. Same graph → same bytes
  verify        Verify the tamper-evident audit chain
  diagnostics   Print the diagnostics recorded when the index was built
  neighborhood  Everything within `depth` hops of an id, both directions (the schema's neighborhood query, now on every surface)
  symbol        One symbol in full: the node, its incident edges grouped by kind and direction, and the counts (the DESIGN §3 dossier)
  search        Find symbols by name — the discovery step the id-based queries assume you already did
  schema        The schema this build speaks: kinds, tiers, query vocabulary
  snapshot      Export the stored graph as a JSON snapshot (+ .proof with a key)
  restore       Restore a snapshot JSON file into a database (verified first: schema, audit chain, and the proof certificate when present; the stored graph is replaced, never unioned)
  verify-proof  Verify a snapshot (schema, audit chain, proof certificate) without restoring it
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version
